card.name: Partway into bacteria words
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the cut-off start of bacteria words such as "bacter" in bacterium, bacteriuria, bacteriophage and Bacteriostatic. It also fires weakly on linking words or commas before biology terms.

modes.label: Bacteria word start
modes.description: The first piece of a word like bacterium or bacteriostatic, before the ending.
modes.example: Presence of<< bacter>>iuria caused by trimethoprim

modes.label: Linker before cell-biology terms
modes.description: A comma, "of" or "and" in lists of cell structures or proteins.
modes.example: Microtubules, microfilaments,<< and>> intermediate filaments which function in cell structure

card.writes: It seems to push toward word starts like "My", "rh" and "op", which suggests Greek-derived biology terms, and away from unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It lights up when a word like bacterium or bacteriostatic is only partly written, and sometimes on small words in microbiology lists.
